paper.title: DAPPER Leiomyosarcoma: Correlation and Survival Analysis of Radiomic, Microbiome and Clinical Data (Code Ocean capsule 3894632)
paper.doi: 10.1158/1078-0432.CCR-23-1137 (companion article, not open access; capsule used as paper text)

claims.text: Univariate Cox models of the reduced feature set identify clinical, radiomic (principal components) and microbiome features associated with overall survival (OS) in the DAPPER LMS cohort.
The same univariate Cox pipeline is applied to progression-free survival (PFS, RECIST v1.1).

Pairwise correlations between radiomic, microbiome and clinical features are computed and exported, with FDR-adjusted p-values, so that associations can be ranked by strength, significance and correlation type.
A reduced feature set for survival analysis is generated by the correlation script and saved as a spreadsheet.
Among the tested features, best RECIST response, grade 3 toxicities and grade 1-2 toxicities are the features most strongly associated with OS after FDR adjustment.

findings.location: results/dp_survival.nb.html OS table, p.adjust column; bp_out/multiverse_summary.json
findings.evidence: The stored OS table reports FDR-adjusted p = 0.021 for Best Response RECISTv1 (HR 0.18), 0.021 for Gr3 Toxicities (HR 2.1) and 0.038 for Gr1 Gr2 Toxicities (HR 0.5). Our Python/lifelines port of the same Rmd on the same released files gives unadjusted p = 0.039 / 0.865 / 0.122 and FDR p = 0.36 / 0.96 / 0.40, i.e. no feature survives FDR (0 of 40). The multiverse over 72 defensible analysis choices holds in 11% of universes and the baseline universe does not hold. Because the baseline is our port (port_gap, see assumptions.md), this is a fragility signal, not a demonstrated error: the stored table's HRs (0.18-2.1) are far from the port's (0.51-1.05) for the same features and data.
findings.question_for_authors: Which data version and script produced the stored OS table? On the released reduced-feature-set.csv the same univariate Cox models give HR 0.51 / 1.05 / 0.62 for these three features, not 0.18 / 2.1 / 0.5.
